_doc: Black Friday / Cyber Monday hub data for discountdealme.com. CJ rows come from a CJ link-search pull for DDM property 101511733. Amazon rows are curated ASINs; each ASIN was opened on amazon.com and matched to the product name. No Amazon prices, ratings or images are stored or shown (no Product Advertising API access). Prices used only to sort products into budget guides were seen on amazon.com on the check date and are not published.

amazon.tag_note: Kyle's only Amazon Associates tracking ID found (in use on tonedntasty.com). Swap for a DDM-specific tracking ID here if one is created.
